Cookie notice

Short answer: this website sets no cookies.

Effective date: 2026-10-23 · Version 1.0

This website

We do not set cookies, use local storage for tracking, or load advertising, analytics or social media trackers. Fonts, scripts and images are served from the same site, so visiting a page does not send your IP address to a font or image provider. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may log technical data about visits under its own privacy statement.

Proposal, check and invite pages

These pages read the data in the part of the web address after the # sign, in your browser. That part is never sent to the server. We do not store it.

If this changes

If we ever need a cookie that is not strictly necessary, we will ask for your consent first and update this page.
